period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own half-yearly Q2-2021 unaudited financial statements (OCR'd from a scanned PDF, cleanly legible). Comparative Balance Sheet column (31 Dec 2020) matches this dataset's existing FY2020 figures exactly for total_assets (529,052,549,451), total_deposits (430,747,950,818) and gross_loans (408,510,601,258). TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY's comparative prints as 52,058,701,994, about 34.86m (0.07%) below this dataset's existing FY2020 equity of 52,093,557,421 -- an immaterial divergence, most likely a small classification difference carried consistently by this and the following quarter's filings (2021_Q3 shows the identical comparative figure), not an extraction error; it is recorded here rather than reconciled, per this dataset's standing practice. Total Liabilities' comparative shows the same offset for the same reason. All current-period (Jun-2021) Balance Sheet and P&L figures are cleanly and directly printed, and every P&L identity holds exactly: Total Operating Income (5,189,120,178) = Net Interest Income (663,643,784) + Investment Income (3,488,325,385) + Commission (759,429,663) + Other Income (277,721,346); Profit Before Provision (1,649,833,408) = Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses (3,539,286,770); Profit Before Tax (899,833,408) = Profit Before Provision - Total Provision (750,000,000); PAT (749,833,408) = Profit Before Tax - Tax (150,000,000). This filing's own Jan-Jun-2020 comparative column was the key source used to correct 2020_Q2.json's net_interest_income (see that record's own note). NAV per share prints as a garbled 'A734'; 17.34 is the OCR-corrected reading (A -> 1), cross-validated against equity/shares = 53,074,233,525 / 3,066,418,639 = 17.31. EPS is the filing's own printed cumulative figure.
